name: Bonus 9: Twilight's Fate
source:
Emily, the swift and spirited fighter-rogue. Ashley, the proud former Witchqueen, stripped of her throne. Samantha, the wise and steadfast cleric, guardian since birth.

Bound by love and purpose, these three heroines set forth on a perilous journey to rescue their beloved Hero from the grasp of Lisbeth, the cruel and cunning Witchqueen who now holds him captive.

What awaits them in the shadows of ancient ruins and cursed strongholds? Can they overcome the trials ahead, or will they fall to Lisbeth’s twisted machinations? Their bonds will be tested. Their hearts laid bare. Their fate… is yours to decide.

[From [url=https://www.azdev.org/download]the official website[/url]]
translation:
艾米丽，敏捷而充满活力的战士流氓。阿什莉，骄傲的前女巫女王，被剥夺了王位。萨曼莎，明智而坚定的牧师，从出生起就是守护者。

受爱情和目标的束缚，这三位女主人公踏上了危险的旅程，将她们心爱的英雄从残酷而狡猾的女巫女王莉兹贝手中救出，莉兹贝现在将他囚禁起来。

在古老废墟和被诅咒的要塞的阴影中等待着他们的是什么？他们能否克服前方的考验，还是会落入莉兹贝的扭曲阴谋之中？他们的关系将受到考验。他们的心暴露无遗。他们的命运……由你决定。
